name: arts
label: ARTS (Retail Technology)
description: Association for Retail Technology Standards — POS, transactions, inventory for large retailers

table_notes.arts_retail_store: Physical or virtual retail location with geospatial coordinates, address JSONB, and timezone for local business-date handling.
table_notes.arts_workstation: POS terminal or self-checkout kiosk registered to a store; tracks hardware identity, type, and liveness via heartbeat.
table_notes.arts_transaction: Header record for a single POS transaction; links store, workstation, operator, and optional loyalty customer with totals.
table_notes.arts_line_item: Individual sale, return, or void entry within a transaction; carries SKU, UPC, quantity, pricing, and tax at the item level.
table_notes.arts_tender: Payment settlement record for a transaction; one row per tender type (cash, card, gift card) with authorization details.

arts_retail_store.name: id
arts_retail_store.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the store

arts_retail_store.name: store_number
arts_retail_store.description: Retailer-assigned store number; unique across the estate (e.g. 0042, SW-NYC-01)

arts_retail_store.name: name
arts_retail_store.description: Human-readable store name or banner (e.g. 'Times Square Flagship')

arts_retail_store.name: address
arts_retail_store.description: Structured postal address: {street, city, state, postal_code, country_code}

arts_retail_store.name: location
arts_retail_store.description: PostGIS point (WGS84) for proximity search and delivery-zone queries

arts_retail_store.name: store_type
arts_retail_store.description: Operational classification: flagship, outlet, kiosk, pop-up, warehouse, etc.

arts_retail_store.name: timezone
arts_retail_store.description: IANA timezone name used to derive local business date (e.g. America/Chicago)

arts_retail_store.name: is_active
arts_retail_store.description: False when a store is permanently closed or temporarily suspended

arts_workstation.name: id
arts_workstation.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the workstation

arts_workstation.name: store_id
arts_workstation.description: Store this workstation belongs to; references arts_retail_store.id

arts_workstation.name: workstation_id
arts_workstation.description: Lane or terminal identifier assigned by the store (e.g. LANE-03, SCO-01)

arts_workstation.name: type
arts_workstation.description: Hardware role: POS, SCO (self-checkout), MPOS (mobile), kiosk, back-office

arts_workstation.name: serial_number
arts_workstation.description: Manufacturer serial number for asset tracking and warranty management

arts_workstation.name: status
arts_workstation.description: Operational state: online, offline, training, maintenance, decommissioned

arts_workstation.name: last_heartbeat_at
arts_workstation.description: Timestamp of the most recent health-check ping; used to detect dead terminals

arts_transaction.name: id
arts_transaction.description: UUID primary key; globally unique across all stores and channels

arts_transaction.name: store_id
arts_transaction.description: Store where this transaction occurred; references arts_retail_store.id

arts_transaction.name: workstation_id
arts_transaction.description: Terminal that recorded this transaction; references arts_workstation.id

arts_transaction.name: transaction_number
arts_transaction.description: Human-readable receipt number, unique within store and business date

arts_transaction.name: transaction_type
arts_transaction.description: ARTS transaction type code: sale, return, void, no-sale, exchange, loan, pickup

arts_transaction.name: business_date
arts_transaction.description: Local store date when this transaction is recorded for reporting (may differ from wall time)

arts_transaction.name: begin_at
arts_transaction.description: Wall-clock timestamp when the cashier opened this transaction

arts_transaction.name: end_at
arts_transaction.description: Wall-clock timestamp when the transaction was completed or voided

arts_transaction.name: operator_id
arts_transaction.description: Cashier or associate badge/login ID who processed this transaction

arts_transaction.name: customer_id
arts_transaction.description: Loyalty or CRM account identifier if the customer was identified at POS

arts_transaction.name: total_amount
arts_transaction.description: Grand total charged to the customer after discounts, before tender (in store currency)

arts_transaction.name: total_tax
arts_transaction.description: Total tax collected across all line items for this transaction

arts_transaction.name: total_discount
arts_transaction.description: Sum of all promotions and manual discounts applied to this transaction

arts_transaction.name: status
arts_transaction.description: Lifecycle state: in-progress, completed, voided, suspended, recalled

arts_line_item.name: id
arts_line_item.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the line item

arts_line_item.name: transaction_id
arts_line_item.description: Parent transaction this line belongs to; references arts_transaction.id

arts_line_item.name: seq_num
arts_line_item.description: 1-based position of this item within the transaction, preserving scan order

arts_line_item.name: item_type
arts_line_item.description: Entry classification: sale, return, void, coupon, fee, deposit, gift-card-activation

arts_line_item.name: sku
arts_line_item.description: Retailer's internal stock-keeping unit code identifying this product variant

arts_line_item.name: upc
arts_line_item.description: Scanned barcode in GTIN-14 format (UPC-A, EAN-13, ITF-14 all normalised to 14 digits)

arts_line_item.name: description
arts_line_item.description: Short product description printed on the receipt

arts_line_item.name: quantity
arts_line_item.description: Sold or returned quantity; negative for returns; fractional for weight/measure items

arts_line_item.name: uom
arts_line_item.description: Unit of measure code per UN/CEFACT: EA (each), KG, LB, LT, etc.

arts_line_item.name: unit_price
arts_line_item.description: Regular selling price per unit before any discounts or promotions

arts_line_item.name: extended_amount
arts_line_item.description: Final net amount for this line: (unit_price * quantity) minus discounts

arts_line_item.name: discount_amount
arts_line_item.description: Total promotion and markdown savings applied to this line item

arts_line_item.name: tax_amount
arts_line_item.description: Tax collected on this line item (may be zero for exempt items)

arts_tender.name: id
arts_tender.description: Auto-incremented surrogate key for the tender row

arts_tender.name: transaction_id
arts_tender.description: Transaction being settled by this tender; references arts_transaction.id

arts_tender.name: tender_type
arts_tender.description: Payment method code: cash, credit, debit, gift-card, check, ewallet, store-credit

arts_tender.name: amount
arts_tender.description: Amount tendered in this payment method (may exceed transaction total for cash change)

arts_tender.name: currency
arts_tender.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this tender (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP)

arts_tender.name: authorization_code
arts_tender.description: Issuer or payment network authorization code returned for card and ewallet tenders

arts_tender.name: card_type
arts_tender.description: Card brand for electronic tenders: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, etc.

arts_tender.name: card_last4
arts_tender.description: Last four digits of the card PAN retained for receipt display (never full PAN)

short_description: Association for Retail Technology Standards — POS, transactions, inventory for large retailers
long_description: ARTS (Association for Retail Technology Standards) provides the data standards used by large retailers for POS, loss prevention, and inventory management. The schema covers the complete in-store transaction lifecycle: workstation registration, transaction headers with operator/customer context, individual sale/return/void line items, and tender settlements.
when_to_use: Use for POS (point-of-sale) software, retail analytics platforms, loss prevention tools, or retail integration middleware. ARTS standards are implemented by Oracle Retail, NCR, Toshiba, and Diebold Nixdorf POS systems. Required for integration with major retailers' inventory and reporting systems. The xTill standard (used in UK retail) is ARTS-aligned.
